question_rules.parent_conditioned: Group across all admissible parents in equal-Q fibres using (Q,A); keep O fixed.
question_rules.standalone_action: Group by A alone and register as a distinct question.

structural_stage_templates.name: CARRIER_INTERFACE_EXTRACTION
structural_stage_templates.question: What exact public interface does each complete G(k-1) carrier expose to the uplift?

structural_stage_templates.name: PAIR_CONNECTION_CENSUS
structural_stage_templates.question: Which ordered/unordered carrier pairs admit each declared connection attempt and what canonical outcomes result?

structural_stage_templates.name: PAIR_OUTCOME_QUOTIENT
structural_stage_templates.question: What is the minimal relabel-invariant quotient of pair connection outcomes under the declared observer?

structural_stage_templates.name: TRIPLE_COMPATIBILITY_IRREDUCIBILITY
structural_stage_templates.question: Are any joint triple facts not reconstructible from all unary interfaces and pair outcomes?

structural_stage_templates.name: COMPOSITION_CLOSURE
structural_stage_templates.question: Are the resulting higher assemblies closed under the candidate connection/composition grammar?

structural_stage_templates.name: CANDIDATE_Gk_STATE_DESCRIPTOR
structural_stage_templates.question: Is there a finite read/write state sufficient for all admitted higher-level transitions?

structural_stage_templates.name: RECURSIVE_CLOSURE_AND_GRADUATION_AUDIT
structural_stage_templates.question: Does the candidate grammar close recursively, survive holdouts, and satisfy every graduation gate?
